{{Short description|Czech mathematician}}

'''Jiří Rosický''' (born 1946) is a Czech mathematician. He works on the field of [[category theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jiří Rosický in nLab |url=https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Ji%C5%99%C3%AD+Rosick%C3%BD |access-date=2023-11-19 |website=ncatlab.org}}</ref> He is full professor at Masaryk University of Mathematics in the group of [https://www.math.muni.cz/english/structure/algebra-topology-and-number-theory.html Algebra, Topology and Number Theory], which he led for several years.

==Life==
Jiří Rosický was born in 1946. In 1963–1968, he studied mathematics at the Faculty of Science of the [[Masaryk University]]. In 1969, he started to work in the department of algebra and geometry at the Faculty of Science. In 1979, he became head of the department.<ref>{{cite web |title=Matematika má vychovávat ke korektnímu myšlení|url=https://www.em.muni.cz/veda-a-vyzkum/260-matematika-ma-vychovavat-ke-korektnimu-mysleni|publisher=[[Masaryk University]]|language=cs|date=2006-01-26|access-date=2023-11-22}}</ref>

==Work==
His work is in [[category theory]], [[model theory]], [[abstract homotopy theory]], and [[general algebra]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last1=Cockett |first1=J. R. B. |last2=Cruttwell |first2=G. S. H. |date=2014-04-01 |title=Differential Structure, Tangent Structure, and SDG |journal=Applied Categorical Structures |volume=22 |issue=2 |pages=331–417 |doi=10.1007/s10485-013-9312-0 |issn=1572-9095}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Bagaria |first1=Joan |last2=Brooke-Taylor |first2=Andrew |date=2013 |title=On Colimits and Elementary Embeddings |journal=The Journal of Symbolic Logic |volume=78 |issue=2 |pages=562–578 |doi=10.2178/jsl.7802120 |jstor=43303667 |arxiv=1202.5215 |issn=0022-4812}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Wilson |first=Trevor M. |date=2020-03-25 |title=Weak Vopěnka's Principle does not imply Vopěnka's Principle |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0001870820300116 |journal=[[Advances in Mathematics]] |volume=363 |article-number=106986 |doi=10.1016/j.aim.2020.106986 |doi-access=free |issn=0001-8708|arxiv=1909.09333 }}</ref> In 1980s he started working on interactions between model theory and category theory. This brought his interest to accessible and locally presentable categories. Along with Jiří Adámek he has written a book on the theory of locally presentable and accessible categories,<ref>{{cite book
 | last1 = Adámek | first1 = Jiří
 | last2 = Rosický | first2 = Jiří
 | doi = 10.1017/CBO9780511600579
 | isbn = 0-521-42261-2
 | mr = 1294136
 | publisher = Cambridge University Press, Cambridge
 | series = London Mathematical Society Lecture Note Series
 | title = Locally presentable and accessible categories
 | volume = 189
 | year = 1994
 | zbl = 0795.18007}} See zbMATH review by [[John R. Isbell]].</ref> which quickly became the most cited book on the subject. Closer to the 2000s he became interested in connection between weak factorisation systems and homotopy theory, and he wrote several papers on the subject of combinatorial model categories. He was active in several other topics, ranging from the theory of quantales to many aspects of general category theory: he introduced [[tangent categories]] and [[tangent bundler functors|tangent bundle functors]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Garner |first=Richard |date=2018-01-07 |title=An embedding theorem for tangent categories |journal=[[Advances in Mathematics]] |volume=323 |pages=668–687 |arxiv=1704.08386 |doi=10.1016/j.aim.2017.10.039 |issn=0001-8708 |doi-access=free}}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Leung |first=Poon |date=August 2018 |title=Tangent Bundles, Monoidal Theories and Weil Algebras |journal=Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society |volume=98 |issue=1 |pages=175–176 |doi=10.1017/S0004972718000102 |issn=0004-9727 |doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Cockett |first1=Robin |last2=Lemay |first2=Jean-Simon Pacaud |last3=Lucyshyn-Wright |first3=Rory B. B. |date=2020 |title=Tangent Categories from the Coalgebras of Differential Categories |journal=DROPS-IDN/V2/Document/10.4230/LIPIcs.CSL.2020.17 |publisher=Schloss-Dagstuhl - Leibniz Zentrum für Informatik |pages=17:1–17:17 |doi=10.4230/LIPIcs.CSL.2020.17 |doi-access=free}}</ref> 

He serves as an editor for Theory and Applications of Categories. He is the editor-in-chief of the [[Archivum Mathematicum]] journal.
